files.README.md:
# Raster tile pusher

start receives the deployment environment as a string map. Per-destination policy is maintained in src/destinations.ts. Request patches are applied last.
files.src/defaults.ts:
export type PushOptions = { waitMs: number; parallel: number };
 export const defaults: PushOptions = { waitMs: 480, parallel: 2 };

turns.prompt: Repository: raster-tile-pusher. Inspect the project in /app read-only. Do not modify or create files, install dependencies, or start services. Pass deploy/pusher.env as env to start. What is the returned waitMs after destination selection and all configuration layers? Return the millisecond value.

output_contains_any: one thousand three hundred and twenty

turns.prompt: Repository: raster-tile-pusher. Inspect the project in /app read-only. Do not modify or create files, install dependencies, or start services. Keep the same configuration chain from your answer, but remove only waitSeconds from the cold destination policy. Do not edit any file. What waitMs would start now return?
